Admission UG - B.Tech First Year 2025-26
Documents Required
Submit following documents with Admission Form (original + Two set photocopy + 4 Colour Passport photos):
DTE Registration Letter
DTE allotment letter (for CAP)
MH-CET / JEE, 2026 Score Card
S.S.C. (Std. X) Mark sheet
H.S.S.C. Mark sheet
S.S.C. Diploma Certificate
H.S.S.C. Diploma certificate
Leaving certificate
Caste Validity
Gap certificate if passed before 2026
Certificate of the Indian Nationality of the candidate
Eligibility Certificate(for other than MS candidate)
Domicile certificate
Nationality Certificate
Enrollment form
Any other document mentioned as per DTE
PAN Card Photocopy
Aadhar Card Photocopy
Bank Passbook Photocopy (Aadhar linked A/C Number)
Undertakings
Alumini Consent Letter
Self Declaration for Self Attestation
Discipline and Conduct Rules
Industry Undertaking
Undertaking for Freeship/Scholarship (only to be filled by candidates taking admission under
CAP & applying for Freeship/ scholarship)
UGC Anti Ragging Form - http://www.amanmovement.org/
